The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] '''G9 droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. An ancient, [[Monster droid/Legends|cobbled together]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] designated [[EG-9]] had wheels scavenged from a G9.<ref name="Expanded Visual Dictionary" />
